fields: h, intro, items [{t, d, icons}], fig (optional): the plate's caption, e.g. "Test joint by [PP joining method]" (through tx, so a placeholder stays one). icons: Icon names in the order the step's text names them.
best_for: HirePath sets the steps into a role as one drawing sheet: the section title and the practical interview's test joint drawn large as a duotone plate on the left, the steps on a slim vertical rail on the right, each with a gate tick, a mono number, its name and line.
